meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 给项目接入 Microsoft Teams 频道:复制并注册 Teams 适配器、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试;再用 Teams CLI 登录、创建机器人、把凭据写入 .env,生成安装链接并把助手接到指定 Teams 用户。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Microsoft Teams 频道、或运行本技能时触发;若 .env 中已存在 Teams 凭据(任一键),则跳过创建步骤直通重启。

say.text: 帮我给项目加上 Microsoft Teams 频道集成。
say.note: 会复制并注册适配器、装依赖、跑注册测试。

say.text: 把 Teams 机器人接到我的 Microsoft 365 账号上。
say.note: 用 Teams CLI 登录创建机器人并写入 .env。

say.text: 重新跑一遍 Teams 接入,我已经有凭据了。
say.note: 已有凭据时跳过创建,直接到重启。

howto.what_en: Adds Microsoft Teams channel support: copies and registers the Teams adapter, installs the pinned dependency, builds and tests it, then via Teams CLI signs in, creates a bot, writes credentials to .env, and returns an install link.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Microsoft Teams channel to the project; if .env already holds a Teams credential (either key), the creation steps are skipped and the flow jumps to Restart.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams channel support to this project.
say_en.note: Copies, registers, builds, and tests the adapter.

say_en.text: Wire the Teams bot to my Microsoft 365 account.
say_en.note: Signs in via Teams CLI, creates the bot, writes .env.

say_en.text: Re-run the Teams setup - I already have credentials.
say_en.note: Skips creation and goes straight to Restart.
